fullDescription: Warm editorial-magazine contact page for a design studio (Aperture): a sticky cream nav, then an asymmetric two-column block on cream textured paper -- a left editorial column with an oversized Fraunces serif 'Get in touch.' headline (the second word a burgundy italic), a human intro, a hairline divider, a circular-outlined-icon contact list (Email / Live canvas / Studio) and a social-icon row, beside a white rounded form card (a burgundy top accent bar, a 'Send a message' serif header + a 'No spam, ever' shield chip, underline-only fields that turn burgundy on focus -- a name/email row, a company/topic-select row, a message textarea -- an opt-in checkbox and a burgundy pill 'Send message' submit), closed by a slim italic-serif footer. prompt:
## Resumo
A warm, editorial-magazine contact page for a design studio (Aperture), built on a single cream-paper-and-burgundy aesthetic with a serif display voice. It opens with a slim sticky translucent nav, then a 'Contact the studio' kicker, then an asymmetric two-column contact block: a left editorial column with an oversized Fraunces serif headline ('Get in / touch.' with the second word set in burgundy italic), a short human intro paragraph, a hairline rule, a three-item contact-details list (Email / Live canvas / Studio, each a circular outlined icon beside a tiny uppercase kicker label + value + helper line) and a 'Follow along' social-icon row; beside it a tall white form card (rounded-[26px], a hairline cream border, a soft burgundy-tinted shadow and a thin burgundy accent bar across the very top) holding a 'Send a message' serif header + a 'No spam, ever' shield chip, then underline-only fields (a name/email row, a company/topic-select row, a full-width message textarea), an opt-in checkbox and a burgundy pill 'Send message' submit. A slim hairline footer ('Aperture, design at the speed of thought.' + a copyright) closes the page. The signature is the editorial pairing of a cream textured paper canvas with a deep burgundy accent and a Fraunces serif display voice, plus underline-only (border-bottom) form inputs that turn burgundy on focus, so the whole thing reads like a get-in-touch page from a print design magazine. The mood is warm, crafted, calm, human and a little literary.

## Estilo Visual
Design a warm, editorial-magazine contact page for a design studio with a serif display voice. Use a cream textured-paper canvas (cream #faf6ef, a deeper creamdeep #f3ecdf) with near-black ink text (#1c1815) and a softer brown body ink (inksoft #4a4138). Use a SINGLE accent: a deep burgundy #7b2d3b, with a darker burgundydeep #5e1f2b for hovers; hairlines and form-field underlines use a warm tan 'line' #e3d8c6 and placeholders are a muted clay #b3a690. Lay a faint paper-grain overlay over the whole page (a 4px radial-dot pattern of rgba(28,24,21,0.035)). Pair Fraunces (a high-contrast optical serif, your display face) with Inter (sans body/UI) via Google Fonts. Let Fraunces carry the drama: an oversized hero H1 ~64px (up to 92px on large screens) at font-weight 400, leading-[0.92], tracking-[-0.02em], with the highlight word set as a burgundy ITALIC block on its own line; set the form-card header and footer line in Fraunces too (footer italic). Use Inter for body copy (~16.5px, leading-[1.7], inksoft) and all micro-type. Make the recurring typographic motif a tiny uppercase 'kicker' label: Inter ~10.5-11px, font-weight 700, UPPERCASE, 0.22em letter-spacing, tinted burgundy on the section eyebrow + contact-detail labels and inksoft on the form-field labels. Keep the form understated and editorial: UNDERLINE-ONLY fields (transparent fill, no box, just a 1px bottom border in the tan 'line' color, pb-2.5) with clay placeholders; on focus turn the underline burgundy and tint that field's label burgundy too (a quiet single-color focus signal). The submit is a burgundy rounded-full pill in cream text that lifts 2px and darkens to burgundydeep on hover. Render contact-detail icons as 44px circles with a thin burgundy/30 border on cream holding a burgundy Phosphor icon, and social icons as 40px 'line'-bordered circles that tint burgundy on hover. Give the form card the page's one real elevation: a white/70 rounded-[26px] panel with a 1px tan border, a soft burgundy-tinted drop shadow (0 30px 60px -30px rgba(94,31,43,0.28)) and a 1.5px-tall full-width burgundy accent bar pinned across its top edge. Use generous rounding only where it counts: rounded-[26px] form card, rounded-full pill button + circular icon tiles + nav CTA. Give nav links an animated burgundy underline that grows from 0 to full width on hover. Use Iconify Phosphor icons (ph:aperture-bold, ph:arrow-up-right-bold, ph:envelope-simple, ph:chat-circle-dots, ph:map-pin-line, ph:shield-check, ph:caret-down, ph:paper-plane-tilt-fill, ph:x-logo, ph:github-logo, ph:discord-logo). Mood: warm, editorial, crafted, calm, human, a touch literary, never cold or techy.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Sticky translucent nav
A sticky top-0 header, z-50, full width, a translucent cream backdrop (bg-cream/85 + backdrop-blur-md) with a 1px line/70 bottom border. Inner row mx-auto max-w-7xl, px-6 (md:px-10), 72px tall (h-[72px]), space-between. Left: the logo = a 32px (w-8 h-8) rounded-full burgundy tile holding a cream ph:aperture-bold icon, beside a Fraunces (.display) ~20px font-weight-600 tight-tracked 'Aperture' wordmark. Center (md+ only): four nav links 'Library' / 'Studio' / 'Pricing' / 'Contact' in 14px font-medium inksoft that darken to ink on hover, each carrying an animated burgundy underline that grows from 0 to full width on hover (a 1px ::after bar). Right: a 'Sign in' text link (inksoft -> ink, sm+ only) and a 'Start designing' button = a rounded-full bg-ink cream pill (~13.5px font-weight-600, px-4.5 py-2.5) with a trailing ph:arrow-up-right-bold that flips to bg-burgundy on hover.

### Section kicker
Inside a relative <main id='contact'> carrying the '.grain' paper-texture overlay, a mx-auto max-w-7xl px-6 (md:px-10) py-16 (md:py-24, lg:py-28) container. Open with a flex items-center gap-3 mb-10 (md:mb-14) eyebrow row: a short 40px-wide 1px horizontal rule in burgundy/60, then a tiny uppercase 'kicker' label (11px, font-weight 700, 0.22em letter-spacing) in burgundy reading 'Contact the studio'.

### Left editorial column (headline + intro + contact details + socials)
A grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-12 (lg:gap-16) items-start. LEFT column = lg:col-span-5. An oversized Fraunces (.display) font-weight-400 H1 in ink, leading-[0.92], tracking-[-0.02em], 64px (sm:80px, lg:92px): 'Get in' on the first line and a block burgundy ITALIC 'touch.' on the second line. Below it (mt-7, max-w-md), a 16.5px leading-[1.7] inksoft intro paragraph: 'Tell us what you're building. We pair every message with a real designer on the team, so you get an answer worth reading, not a ticket number.' Then a mt-10 mb-9 full-width 1px 'line' divider. Then a space-y-7 contact-details list of three items, each a flex items-start gap-4 row: a 44px (w-11 h-11) rounded-full circle with a 1px burgundy/30 border on cream holding a 20px burgundy Phosphor icon, beside a block with a tiny uppercase burgundy/80 'kicker' label (10.5px, 0.22em), a 16px font-medium ink value, and a 14px inksoft helper line. Item 1: ph:envelope-simple / 'Email' / 'studio@aperture.design' / 'We reply within one working day.' Item 2: ph:chat-circle-dots / 'Live canvas' / 'Share a prompt, get a mockup' / 'Jump straight onto the infinite canvas.' Item 3: ph:map-pin-line / 'Studio' / 'Remote, working hours overlap' / 'UTC-8 to UTC+8, async first.' Then a mt-11 mb-4 uppercase inksoft/80 'kicker' 'Follow along' label over a flex gap-3 row of three 40px (w-10 h-10) rounded-full 'line'-bordered social-icon circles (ph:x-logo, ph:github-logo, ph:discord-logo) in inksoft that tint burgundy (icon + border burgundy/40) on hover.

### Right form card
RIGHT column = lg:col-span-7. A relative rounded-[26px] panel with a 1px 'line' border, a white/70 backdrop-blur-sm fill, a soft burgundy-tinted shadow (0 30px 60px -30px rgba(94,31,43,0.28)) and overflow-hidden, with a 1.5px-tall (h-1.5) full-width burgundy accent bar pinned across its very top edge. Inside, p-8 (sm:p-10, lg:p-12). A header row (flex items-baseline justify-between): a Fraunces (.display) ~26px (sm:30px) font-weight-500 tight-tracked 'Send a message' H2, and (sm+ only) a small burgundy chip = a ph:shield-check icon + a 12.5px font-medium 'No spam, ever' label. Then a mt-9 space-y-7 <form>: a grid sm:grid-cols-2 gap-7 row of a 'Full name' field ('Jane Mercer') and an 'Email address' field ('jane@studio.com'); a grid sm:grid-cols-2 gap-7 row of a 'Company' field ('Optional') and a 'What's on your mind?' SELECT (A new project / Library access / Partnership / Something else) with a trailing ph:caret-down; a full-width 'Message' field = a 4-row resize-none textarea ('Tell us about the screens you want to design, and where you're stuck.'). Each field carries a tiny uppercase 'kicker' label (10.5px, font-weight 700, 0.22em) in inksoft, and every input/textarea/select is UNDERLINE-ONLY (transparent, border-0 with just a 1px bottom border in 'line', pb-2.5, 16px ink text, clay placeholders); on focus the underline turns burgundy (#7b2d3b) and the field's label tints burgundy. Close the form with a flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-5 pt-2 row: a left opt-in checkbox label (a 16px accent-burgundy checkbox + a 13.5px inksoft 'Send me the weekly prompt drop. No more than one email a week.' max-w-xs line) and a right burgundy rounded-full pill submit (px-8 py-4, 15px font-weight-600 cream text, a trailing ph:paper-plane-tilt-fill, reading 'Send message') that lifts 2px and darkens to burgundydeep on hover.

### Footer
Close the page with a footer carrying a 1px 'line' top border. Inner mx-auto max-w-7xl px-6 (md:px-10) py-7, stacking centered on mobile and space-between on sm+ in 13px inksoft: left a Fraunces (.display) ITALIC 15px ink line 'Aperture, design at the speed of thought.' and right a copyright '(c) 2026 Aperture Studio. All rights reserved.'

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Componente
Oversized serif headline with a burgundy italic highlight: a Fraunces (.display) font-weight-400 H1 up to 92px, leading-[0.92], tracking-[-0.02em], with 'Get in' on one line and a block BURGUNDY ITALIC 'touch.' on the next, the page's editorial centerpiece.

### Componente
Underline-only form fields with a burgundy focus signal: every input/textarea/select is transparent with no box, only a 1px bottom border in the warm 'line' tan (#e3d8c6) and clay (#b3a690) placeholders; on focus the underline turns burgundy (#7b2d3b) and that field's tiny uppercase 'kicker' label tints burgundy too, a quiet single-color focus state.

### Componente
Form card with a burgundy top accent bar + soft tinted shadow: a white/70 rounded-[26px] panel with a 1px 'line' border, a soft burgundy-tinted drop shadow (0 30px 60px -30px rgba(94,31,43,0.28)) and a 1.5px-tall full-width burgundy accent bar pinned across its very top edge, the page's single piece of real elevation.

### Componente
Tiny uppercase 'kicker' labels: a recurring typographic motif of Inter ~10.5-11px, font-weight 700, uppercase, 0.22em letter-spacing -- burgundy on the section eyebrow + contact-detail labels, inksoft on the form-field labels + 'Follow along' -- tying the editorial page together.

### Componente
Circular outlined contact-detail icons: 44px (w-11 h-11) rounded-full circles with a thin burgundy/30 border on cream holding a 20px burgundy Phosphor icon (ph:envelope-simple / ph:chat-circle-dots / ph:map-pin-line), each beside a kicker label + value + helper line.

### Componente
Paper-grain texture overlay: a faint '.grain' background layer over the contact main, a 4px radial-dot pattern of rgba(28,24,21,0.035), giving the cream canvas a subtle printed-paper feel.

### Componente
Burgundy rounded-full pill submit: a px-8 py-4 burgundy (#7b2d3b) rounded-full button in cream text with a trailing ph:paper-plane-tilt-fill that lifts 2px (translateY -2px) and darkens to burgundydeep (#5e1f2b) on hover.

### Componente
Animated nav underline + 'No spam, ever' shield chip: nav links carry a 1px burgundy ::after underline that grows from 0 to full width on hover, and the form header carries a small inline burgundy chip (a ph:shield-check icon + a 'No spam, ever' label).

## Notas Especiais
Keep the warm editorial / magazine system: a cream textured-paper canvas (cream #faf6ef, deeper creamdeep #f3ecdf) under a faint 4px radial-dot '.grain' overlay (rgba(28,24,21,0.035)), near-black ink headings (#1c1815) over softer brown body ink (inksoft #4a4138), and a SINGLE deep-burgundy accent (#7b2d3b, with burgundydeep #5e1f2b for hovers); hairlines, field underlines and icon borders use a warm tan 'line' (#e3d8c6) and placeholders are a muted clay (#b3a690). Pair Fraunces (a high-contrast optical serif, the '.display' face) with Inter (sans body/UI) via Google Fonts: let Fraunces carry an oversized hero H1 ~64px (up to 92px on lg) at font-weight 400, leading-[0.92], tracking-[-0.02em], with the highlight word set as a BURGUNDY ITALIC block on its own line, and set the form-card header + footer line in Fraunces too (footer italic); use Inter for ~16.5px leading-[1.7] inksoft body and a recurring tiny uppercase 'kicker' label (Inter ~10.5-11px, weight 700, 0.22em letter-spacing, burgundy on the eyebrow/contact labels, inksoft on the field labels). The signature is the asymmetric two-column block (lg:grid-cols-12): a LEFT editorial column (lg:col-span-5) of the serif headline + a human intro + a hairline divider + a three-item circular-outlined-icon contact list (Email / Live canvas / Studio) + a 'Follow along' social-icon row, beside a RIGHT form card (lg:col-span-7) = a white/70 rounded-[26px] panel with a 1px 'line' border, a soft burgundy-tinted shadow (0 30px 60px -30px rgba(94,31,43,0.28)) and a 1.5px burgundy accent bar across its top, holding a 'Send a message' serif header + a 'No spam, ever' shield chip and UNDERLINE-ONLY fields (a name/email row, a company/topic-select row, a message textarea) that turn burgundy on focus, an opt-in checkbox + a burgundy rounded-full pill 'Send message' submit (lift 2px + darken to burgundydeep on hover). Frame it with a sticky translucent nav (a burgundy ph:aperture-bold circle logo + a Fraunces 'Aperture' wordmark, Library/Studio/Pricing/Contact links with an animated burgundy underline, a 'Sign in' link + a bg-ink 'Start designing' pill) and close with a slim hairline footer (a Fraunces italic 'Aperture, design at the speed of thought.' + a copyright). Everything must reflow cleanly: the two-column block collapses to one column below lg (the editorial column stacks over the form card), the name/email and company/topic rows go single-column below sm, the nav center links hide below md and the 'Sign in' link below sm, the footer stacks centered on mobile, and there is no horizontal overflow at 390px. Copy is warm, human and a touch literary with zero em-dashes ('Get in touch.', 'so you get an answer worth reading, not a ticket number.', 'We reply within one working day.'). Use Iconify Phosphor icons (ph:aperture-bold, ph:arrow-up-right-bold, ph:envelope-simple, ph:chat-circle-dots, ph:map-pin-line, ph:shield-check, ph:caret-down, ph:paper-plane-tilt-fill, ph:x-logo, ph:github-logo, ph:discord-logo).

structured.special_notes: Keep the warm editorial / magazine system: a cream textured-paper canvas (cream #faf6ef, deeper creamdeep #f3ecdf) under a faint 4px radial-dot '.grain' overlay (rgba(28,24,21,0.035)), near-black ink headings (#1c1815) over softer brown body ink (inksoft #4a4138), and a SINGLE deep-burgundy accent (#7b2d3b, with burgundydeep #5e1f2b for hovers); hairlines, field underlines and icon borders use a warm tan 'line' (#e3d8c6) and placeholders are a muted clay (#b3a690). Pair Fraunces (a high-contrast optical serif, the '.display' face) with Inter (sans body/UI) via Google Fonts: let Fraunces carry an oversized hero H1 ~64px (up to 92px on lg) at font-weight 400, leading-[0.92], tracking-[-0.02em], with the highlight word set as a BURGUNDY ITALIC block on its own line, and set the form-card header + footer line in Fraunces too (footer italic); use Inter for ~16.5px leading-[1.7] inksoft body and a recurring tiny uppercase 'kicker' label (Inter ~10.5-11px, weight 700, 0.22em letter-spacing, burgundy on the eyebrow/contact labels, inksoft on the field labels). The signature is the asymmetric two-column block (lg:grid-cols-12): a LEFT editorial column (lg:col-span-5) of the serif headline + a human intro + a hairline divider + a three-item circular-outlined-icon contact list (Email / Live canvas / Studio) + a 'Follow along' social-icon row, beside a RIGHT form card (lg:col-span-7) = a white/70 rounded-[26px] panel with a 1px 'line' border, a soft burgundy-tinted shadow (0 30px 60px -30px rgba(94,31,43,0.28)) and a 1.5px burgundy accent bar across its top, holding a 'Send a message' serif header + a 'No spam, ever' shield chip and UNDERLINE-ONLY fields (a name/email row, a company/topic-select row, a message textarea) that turn burgundy on focus, an opt-in checkbox + a burgundy rounded-full pill 'Send message' submit (lift 2px + darken to burgundydeep on hover). Frame it with a sticky translucent nav (a burgundy ph:aperture-bold circle logo + a Fraunces 'Aperture' wordmark, Library/Studio/Pricing/Contact links with an animated burgundy underline, a 'Sign in' link + a bg-ink 'Start designing' pill) and close with a slim hairline footer (a Fraunces italic 'Aperture, design at the speed of thought.' + a copyright). Everything must reflow cleanly: the two-column block collapses to one column below lg (the editorial column stacks over the form card), the name/email and company/topic rows go single-column below sm, the nav center links hide below md and the 'Sign in' link below sm, the footer stacks centered on mobile, and there is no horizontal overflow at 390px. Copy is warm, human and a touch literary with zero em-dashes ('Get in touch.', 'so you get an answer worth reading, not a ticket number.', 'We reply within one working day.'). Use Iconify Phosphor icons (ph:aperture-bold, ph:arrow-up-right-bold, ph:envelope-simple, ph:chat-circle-dots, ph:map-pin-line, ph:shield-check, ph:caret-down, ph:paper-plane-tilt-fill, ph:x-logo, ph:github-logo, ph:discord-logo).
